title: Butterscotch cake near Wentworthville or Toongabbie? 100% eggless, Harris Park
summary:
Butterscotch cake for Wentworthville and Toongabbie families, 100% eggless, made at Harris Park.

Looking for an eggless butterscotch cake for a birthday and tired of asking every bakery if it has egg? Here the answer is always no. Every cake we make is 100% eggless, so there is nothing to check.

An 8 inch serves 12 to 14 and starts at $49.99. Order today, collect the day after tomorrow. We are open 11am to 10pm every day, which suits a pickup after work on the way home from Wentworthville or Toongabbie.

Pick your flavour and size online. Wording on the cake is piped by hand.
